nodes.title: Pack Lazada order
nodes.description: Pack order items for shipping (/order/fulfill/pack): returns the package ids. After a network error or timeout the change may still have been applied: check before retrying. Check with get_order_items.

pack_request.description: The packReq object of Lazada's /order/fulfill/pack docs, e.g. {pack_order_list: [{order_id, order_item_list: [...]}], delivery_type: "dropship", shipping_allocate_type: "TFS"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Mark Lazada packages ready to ship
nodes.description: Set packed packages ready to ship (/order/package/rts), which books the pickup. After a network error or timeout the change may still have been applied: check before retrying. Check with get_order_items.

ready_to_ship_request.description: The readyToShipReq object of Lazada's /order/package/rts docs, e.g. {packages: [{package_id: "FP..."}]}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: API result
